_doc: SCAFFOLD for candidate C1 (HVI-PLAN.md §4 once Gate 0 passes). src does not exist yet; gen-table.py renders every cell as -- and prints MISSING. Contract for experiment: the C1 run export c1__colorspace_v1.json carries analysis.analysis_c1.decision.summary.<cond>.<metric>.{mean,sd,n} with cond in {srgb,hsv,ycbcr,hvi_nock,hvi}, metric in {psnr,ssim,lpips,delta_e00,psnr_gated,ssim_gated,lpips_gated,psnr_gtmean,ssim_gtmean,lpips_gtmean}, computed over the 3 seeds from the one final test evaluation per condition. Keys containing {cond} are expanded per row from the row's job. Neither table is \input by the paper until the src exists.

tables.name: c1_colorspace
tables.label: tab:c1
tables.caption: \textbf{Color space under an identical network.} \mname trained in each color space with the same architecture, loss, schedule, and seeds on \dataset; PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and CIEDE2000 on the test split, evaluated once per condition by the final-evaluation script after validation-based checkpoint selection, on \hw. Cells are the mean over three seeds with the seed SD beside them; no gating and no GT-mean rescaling. The best mean in each column is in \textbf{bold}, whichever color space attains it.

Mean over three seeds with the seed SD beside it. The best mean in each column is in \textbf{bold}, whichever color space attains it.
